title: The Enhanced Games — tech’s steroid extravaganza — didn’t pay off, as company posts $60 million loss
summary: Earlier this week, the Enhanced Group, the company that put on the games, posted its second-quarter earnings report, revealing that the company had suffered a net loss of nearly $62 million.
